⚠️ IMPORTANT: Every asset in this game is completely original and developed by our in-house team.

📢 Be sure to join our official community linked below the description to stay updated on news, announcements, and exclusive codes.
If you are an official Blue Lock developer and have any concerns, please reach out to us privately.

This is an unofficial fan-made project, created by dedicated fans as a tribute to Blue Lock and its intense competitive energy.

⚽ Step into the fierce world of BL:Recreation — a high-speed soccer experience inspired by Blue Lock. Compete in thrilling 5v5 matches where skill, strategy, and ego clash at every moment.

🔥 Choose your playstyle with distinct character classes, each offering unique abilities inspired by the series. Unlock your potential, make clutch plays, and push your way toward becoming the ultimate striker.
